requirements.text: - BS / MS in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics, or related field).
- 3+ years of data science or product analytics experience, delivering hands-on insights for consumer-facing production applications.
- Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language used for data analysis (e.g., Python or R).
- Solid understanding of statistical concepts, experimental design (A/B testing), and core product metrics (retention, conversion, engagement).
- Experience working in an incubator, startup, or "0 to 1" product environment.
- Strong business acumen with a proven track record of turning ambiguous, messy data into structured, actionable product recommendations.
- Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker) and distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Hive, Spark).
